metadata.description: Hosted billing. Stripe needs the two Key Vault secrets stripe-api-key and stripe-webhook-signing-secret and both price ids (see docs/security/billing.md); None turns plans and limits off.
Stripe price id of Relio Pro billed monthly ($2 / month). Required when billingProvider is Stripe.
Stripe price id of Relio Pro billed yearly ($12 / year). Required when billingProvider is Stripe.
Public origin of the site, used for canonical URLs and the Stripe return URLs.
ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT. Staging turns on noindex headers and robots.txt (the app gates indexing on Production).
Registration:Mode. The first account is always allowed and becomes the administrator, whatever the mode.
Data Protection application name, so one environment never shares a key purpose with another.

true: Kudu/Oryx builds Relio.Web from source on deploy (how production was first deployed). false: the deployed zip is already `dotnet publish` output (the release and staging workflows) and the app starts with `dotnet Relio.Web.dll`.
